video_title: Why Was OG Anunoby WIDE Open On The Game-Winner?

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' reliance on Jalen Brunson and defensive pressure
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks don't have a lot of shot creators outside of Brunson.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: The Knicks don't have a lot of shot creators outside of Brunson. Putting the ball in the half court in Karl-Anthony Towns' hands was a shot creation. But Victor Wembanyama cuts away all of the back-door cuts, all of the back-screens. Wembanyama cleans that up, so that's not effective. They have a bunch of big guards on Brunson. Josh Hart can kind of handle it. You don't want OG Anunoby or any of their other wings handling it with the type of pressure that San Antonio can. So Jose Alvarado has been key.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: Did you see the last two shots that he shot?

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: Okay, so let me break it down. Jose Alvarado puts another ball-handler on the floor. Jose had never played as many minutes as he did last game because they needed it. Why? One, Brunson in the last second, he can get a shot off anybody. So you do not want him shooting the ball in the last minute. You want to force somebody else into a shot creation or a shot.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs' defensive strategy against Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: They figured out what Wembanyama can't block. When you drive right at him and stop and pull.
quotes.quote: I would say anybody else but Brunson. I don't care if Jose Alvarado shoots this. I could go to sleep at night if he makes a miraculous shot. One thing I noticed in the game, and Alvarado I think did it maybe the game before, they figured out what Wembanyama can't block. When you drive right at him and stop and pull, he can't move his feet like that. He's too big, too long and lanky. So Alvarado and Brunson have figured out that the pull-up middy, or a hard pull-up as he's backing up, he can't back up with his long self and jump and block it. So that's why I think for me, Jalen Brunson took that quick three at the end of the game.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs' missed opportunity to win despite breaking records
quotes.excerpt: They broke an NBA record. They shot the ball well and it was a tale of two halves.
quotes.quote: They broke an NBA record. They shot the ball well and it was a tale of two halves. Some of the early threes, but you get stuck in this rhythm. You've seen the ball go through the hole so many times, you miss a couple and you're up 18, you're like, 'Fine, all it takes is for us to hit two of the shots that we've been hitting and now we're back up.' They just never started. And I think that's, we talk about experience, inexperience, some of it, one, experience is kind of that recognition.
